purpose: Review high-leverage repeated component signatures so one manual topology decision can safely cover multiple release variants through exact-signature propagation.

head_evidence.part_name: Minifig Head Cragger, Dual Sided, Crocodile with Dark Brown Eye Scales, White Teeth and Red Scar, Wide Eye / Narrow Eye Print

headgear_evidence.part_name: Mask Crocodile with Teeth and Red Scar Print

records.training_note: The cylindrical head carries expression and inner face detail while the separate crocodile mask supplies jaw/snout silhouette. Exact signature repeats across numerous Cragger releases, so physical topology can propagate to those variants.

headgear_evidence.part_name: Mask Bird (Eagle) with Yellow Beak, Gold Headdress and Blue Feathers Print

records.training_note: Eris uses the same species-identity strategy seen in other Chima bird characters: a standard printed head plus separate eagle/beak/headdress mask geometry.

head_evidence.part_name: Head Special, Rock Monster, Jaw Upper [Type 1]

records.training_note: Identity is carried by dedicated rock-monster head geometry rather than a decorated standard 3626 head or removable mask. The same head signature is reused across several elemental/color variants.

head_evidence.part_name: Minifig Head Captain America, Dark Brown Eyebrows, Grin with Raised Right Eyebrow / Reddish Brown Chinstrap Print

headgear_evidence.part_name: Helmet / Mask, Top Hole, White Wings, White 'A' Print (Captain America)

records.training_note: Captain America's face and chinstrap are printed on the underlying head while the separate helmet/mask carries the iconic A, wing details, and silhouette. This is identity-bearing superhero headgear rather than generic protection.

head_evidence.part_name: Minifig Head Worriz, Dual Sided, Wolf with Yellow Eyes, Black Scars, Fangs, Closed Mouth / Open Mouth Print

headgear_evidence.part_name: Mask Wolf with Face Details, Scars and White Ears Print

records.training_note: Wolf identity is split between a standard printed head and removable wolf-face geometry. The exact signature repeats across several Worriz variants, making it a strong route-topology propagation anchor.

systemic_findings: Selecting representatives from large exact-signature groups greatly increases review coverage without weakening source-translation safeguards.
Anthropomorphic species faces repeatedly use a standard printed head underneath silhouette-bearing removable species masks.
Dedicated nonhuman head geometry should remain a separate route from masks layered over standard cylindrical heads.
Identity-bearing superhero helmets can be physically protective in-world while still functioning as character-identity geometry for representation modeling.
